name: zvideo_dd3d_texture_record_unlock_upload_surface
description: zVideo_dd3d::TextureRecord_UnlockUploadSurface unlocks a texture record's upload surface and returns a normalized success flag.
known_limits: VC5SP3 target zvideo_dd3d_texture_record_lifecycle passes for 0x4aa8f0 with zero unmasked byte mismatches, 4 relocation-masked bytes, and 3 trimmed VC NOPs, but tier S remains deferred until direct callee 0x4a8160 zVideo_dd::UnlockSurface_WaitRestore is accepted at tier S.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4aa8f0 validates the zvid_ddd3d.c source file, fastcall ECX=zVideo_TextureRecord*, dereference of m_uploadSurface at offset 0, direct call to zVideo_dd::UnlockSurface_WaitRestore, and neg/sbb/inc normalization returning 1 when UnlockSurface_WaitRestore returns 0 and 0 otherwise.

Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4aa8f0 has no warning tags. The only direct callee is zVideo_dd::UnlockSurface_WaitRestore, accepted at tier C or better; DirectDraw unlock and restore provider calls are handled inside that accepted boundary.

The native smoke uses the fake DirectDrawSurface3 provider to verify successful unlock dispatch and null unlock argument propagation, plus provider failure returning 0 without a restore retry for a generic unlock failure.
